definition: AWS CloudFormation Basics is a core concept in AWS Developer Associate. It refers to the techniques, principles and practices that let a practitioner work effectively with this topic in real systems.

theory.heading: What AWS CloudFormation Basics is
theory.body: AWS CloudFormation Basics describes the methods and patterns used within AWS Developer Associate to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: AWS CloudFormation Basics is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.

theory.heading: Why AWS CloudFormation Basics matters
theory.body: Without AWS CloudFormation Basics, systems built with AWS Developer Associate are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How AWS CloudFormation Basics works
theory.body: The mechanism behind AWS CloudFormation Basics follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of AWS CloudFormation Basics.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of AWS CloudFormation Basics
theory.body: AWS CloudFormation Basics offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
